result.description: Online payments platform: payments, billing/subscriptions, invoicing, payouts, Connect marketplaces, and more via API.
result.auth_detail: Secret/restricted API keys sent via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username) or Bearer header. OAuth 2.0 for Stripe Apps and Connect platforms to act on behalf of other accounts.
result.access_detail: Anyone can create a Stripe account and get test-mode (sandbox) keys without charge; no fees until live payments are processed. OAuth for Connect/Apps is self-serve; publishing a Stripe App to the marketplace needs Stripe review. Free signup not directly quoted from docs, so access confidence is medium.
result.api_notes: Resource-oriented REST API with JSON responses and form-encoded requests; hundreds of endpoints across Payments, Billing, Invoicing, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, Tax, Radar, etc. Official SDKs in many languages. Webhooks supported.

evidence.quote: Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
The Stripe API authenticates requests using HTTP Basic Auth.
Use industry standard OAuth 2.0 to generate access tokens to interact with the Stripe API.
Test mode secret keys start with `sk_test_` and have unrestricted access to their sandboxes.
